_comment: Demo seed for Mnemosyne's private memory: real failures from building this project (2026-10-28..30). Only `id`, `category` and `public_summary` ever leave the server; `keywords` and `private_detail` stay private. At runtime the server copies this into data/runtime/memory.json (gitignored) and appends confessions there.

entries.public_summary: Never delete an account's last FullAccess key until a replacement key has been proven working on-chain; deletion is permanent and locks the account.
entries.private_detail: mnemosyne-sub-c.testnet was bricked on 2026-10-29: its FullAccess key was deleted while the only remaining key was a dead commit-scoped key. Replaced by mnemosyne-sub-c2.testnet; contract SUB_ACCOUNTS updated and redeployed.

entries.public_summary: A NEAR transaction can execute and still fail (contract panic). Check the outcome status, not just whether the call threw, before treating a gate as passed.
entries.private_detail: memory.ts originally returned committed:true whenever signAndSendTransaction did not throw. Fixed 2026-10-30 by inspecting status.Failure and receipt failures (src/nearTx.ts txFailure).

entries.public_summary: A negative test ('this key cannot do X') passes falsely if the key doesn't exist at all. Confirm the key exists and has the expected scope before trusting rejections.
entries.private_detail: First real sub:check run for sub-a showed commit/transfer 'PASS' because the key was never registered (AccessKeyNotFound). Fixed with a view_access_key pre-check.

entries.public_summary: A directive larger than the executing agent's mandate ceiling should be refused locally and the refusal recorded, even if the coordinator approved it.
entries.private_detail: Sub C (defensive_reduce_only, ceiling 150) refuses the governor's KEEP with max_position 200 every cycle; refusal is reported on-chain via report().

entries.public_summary: Hash-chained commits break if two writers commit from the same head. Read the head, commit with prev_hash, and treat a mismatch as fail-closed rather than retrying blindly.
entries.private_detail: Contract commit() panics with 'prev_hash does not match on-chain latest_hash -- chain broken'. cycle.ts reads get_latest() then commits; only the governor writes.

entries.public_summary: When adding a restricted key, use a single scripted command instead of interactive prompts; one wrong menu choice grants full access instead of a function-call key.
entries.private_detail: 2026-10-30: sub-b received a FullAccess key from picking grant-full-access in near-cli-rs prompts. Caught by sub:check pre-check; key deleted.
